cbecs_question: Does the building automation system control the {heating/cooling} and/or lighting? Heating? / Cooling?
assumption: a BAS that controls heating or cooling reads zone temperature and setpoints, and the supply-air temperature and run status of the systems it commands. SAT presumes an air system; hydronic-only buildings would not carry it
linked_note: census (45 graphs): T linked 23 of 30 declaring it, Sp 17/23, SAT 32/40, Run 23/33

cbecs_question: Does the building automation system control ... lighting?
assumption: BAS lighting control taken as occupancy-driven. As a sensitivity only: a BAS that only schedules lighting would carry no occupancy stream; CBECS does not separate the two
linked_note: census: Occ declared in 2 graphs, linked in 1

cbecs_question: Occupancy sensors that reduce lighting when rooms are unoccupied?
assumption: declared, not linked: lighting occupancy sensors are usually local devices with no network point; the discount carries this
linked_note: census: Occ declared in 2 graphs, linked in 1

cbecs_question: Does this building use any 'smart' or internet-connected thermostats?
assumption: an internet-connected thermostat exposes zone temperature and setpoint. Asked only of buildings WITHOUT a BAS (EMCS = 2), so the row cannot fire in BAS buildings

cbecs_question: Lighting scheduling (lights automatically dimmed or turned off at certain times)?
assumption: a time schedule adds no stream class

cbecs_question: Multi-level lighting or dimming?
assumption: a dimming device adds no stream class

cbecs_question: Demand controlled ventilation (DCV)?
assumption: DCV taken as CO2-based (90.1 §6.4.3.8 also allows occupancy-based DCV).
linked_note: census: CO2 declared in 1 graph, linked in 1

cbecs_question: Daylight harvesting (automatically dims light fixtures when natural light is available)?
assumption: daylight harvesting needs a photosensor, i.e. illuminance, which the canon's Lgt class includes ('lighting power, lighting status, or illuminance').

cbecs_question: Variable air volume (VAV) system?
assumption: BAS-controlled VAV boxes carry damper command and position or airflow.
linked_note: census: ActC linked 16 of 26 declaring it, ActP 13/17

cbecs_question: Does the building automation system control ... lighting?
assumption: a BAS that commands lighting holds the lighting on/off status (Lgt includes lighting status).

cbecs_question: Dedicated outside air system (DOAS)?
assumption: no stream assumed: a DOAS need not measure outdoor-air flow

cbecs_question: Economizer cycle?
assumption: an economizer's high-limit control cannot decide when to use outside air without sensing outdoor-air temperature or enthalpy (90.1 §6.5.1; Table C row C12 sources S12/S14). Grade: strong tier
linked_note: census: OAT linked 31 of 39 declaring it

cbecs_question: District chilled water / district steam or hot water used?
assumption: district energy is sold by metered quantity, so a thermal-energy revenue meter exists, as the electricity utility meter does; the canon's end-use submeter class names thermal energy. Grade: strong tier
linked_note: census: Sub linked 12 of 22 declaring it

cbecs_question: Central chillers used for cooling? / BAS controls cooling?
assumption: a BAS that commands a chiller plant reads whether it runs and what it delivers (chilled-water temperatures or flow). Grade: moderate-strong tier
linked_note: census: Run linked 23 of 33, Load 25 of 31

cbecs_question: Boilers used for heating? / BAS controls heating?
assumption: a BAS that commands a heating plant reads whether it runs and what it delivers (hot-water temperatures or flow). Grade: moderate-strong tier
linked_note: census: Run linked 23 of 33, Load 25 of 31

cbecs_question: BAS controls heating or cooling?
assumption: occupied/unoccupied scheduling is a BAS's most basic function, so a scheduled setpoint exists apart from the setpoint in effect; whether it is kept as its own point varies by system. Grade: moderate tier, high leverage (last class missing for thermal diagnosis where ActC, ActP and SAT are declared); also reported alone
linked_note: census: SpC declared in 1 graph, linked in 0

cbecs_question: Demand responsive lighting (reduces lighting at times of peak demand)?
assumption: dimming lights on a utility signal requires networked lighting control that knows the lighting state. Grade: moderate tier

cbecs_question: VRF system?
assumption: a VRF central controller reports indoor-unit temperature, setpoint and run state ('don't know' counted as no). Grade: moderate tier

cbecs_question: plant + BAS
assumption: chiller or boiler input power is often integrated into the BAS, but not reliably. Grade: weak tier: sensitivity only

cbecs_question: Formal energy management plan in which energy targets are set and consistently monitored?
assumption: a plan with monitored targets suggests some end-use monitoring, but targets can be tracked from utility bills alone. Grade: weak tier: sensitivity only
